Das Nachdenkbudget nutzt versteckte Ausgabe-Tokens vor der sichtbaren Antwort. Höhere Werte können schwierige Aufgaben verbessern, sind aber möglicherweise langsamer und teurer.

Kostenlos, kein API-Key. Web-Scraping von lite.duckduckgo.com. Kann instabil sein und Bot-Schutz auslösen.
Free live search via Monid. Needs your Monid API key. Browser-rendered, never cached.
DuckDuckGo scraping + Monid TinyFish in parallel, de-duplicated. Strongest results; needs a Monid key, works without it too.
Monid key (monid_live_...) from app.monid.ai - optional, improves results
Agent mode, workspace folder, ensemble models, Jev status
Normal answers, tools as configured today. Default.
Research only: read-only tools (read, search, list). No shell execution, no file writes.
Full agent: all tools, file reports/PDFs, multi-model answers. Mutations still ask for confirmation.
Pick a project folder for %1$s mode. The agent only reads and writes inside it.
Not set - tap to pick a folder. Files go to app storage until then.
Up to 5 models (in order). ask_models fans out to all of them; the chat model synthesizes.
No more models available. Sync models under Providers first.
TypeSafe key set - routing, re-rank and guardrails active.
Not set - add your key under Providers, TypeSafe entry, for smarter routing and re-rank.
Every %1$d tool turns, Jev drops low-value tool outputs from the model\'s view. Full history is always kept. Only runs when Jev is enabled.
Exported into every shell command as $NAME for API calls. Values stay encrypted.
None yet. Add API keys the agent may use in shell commands.
A persistent AgentX log records lifecycle, requests, tool calls, errors and crashes. Tap to share for debugging.
No log yet - it starts automatically on next launch.
Öffentliche Instanzen sind oft ratenbegrenzt. Für zuverlässige Nutzung wird Selbst-Hosting empfohlen.

Decision model: search re-rank, pruning, guardrails
Use the Jev decision model to sharpen the agent: re-rank web results, prune useless context, guard answers. Only runs when enabled.
Typed model name. No picker needed.
Paste one key per line, then Add. Decisions rotate across keys to spread load and avoid rate limits.
Paste keys here, one per line
Web-search re-ranking, prune_context tool, answer guardrails. All fail open: if Jev is down, the agent just works without it.
Jev (TypeSafe, ~32k context) or Drex by Nace AI (wire-compatible, drex-v1.5 has a 131k context window). The agent uses whichever is selected.
No keys yet — paste at least one above.
drex-v1.5 (default, 131,072-token context) · drex-v1.0 · drex-latest (moving alias, currently v1.5).
Paste one nace_sk_ key per line, then Add. Max 3 active keys per Drex account. Decisions rotate across keys.
Paste nace_sk_ keys here, one per line
Read social posts via your own FxEmbed worker
Let the agent read posts from X, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, Threads and Mastodon through your own FxEmbed worker. Read-only — the agent never posts.
Your own FxEmbed worker base URL (https only). No default is shipped — deploy your own instance.
Not validated yet — paste your worker URL and tap Validate.
Deploy your own free FxEmbed worker (docs: docs.fxembed.com/deployment), then paste its URL above. The app never stores or sends any social API keys — reading needs none.
Paste one API key per line. All keys will be added and the agent will rotate across them automatically to spread load and avoid rate limits.
Paste keys here, one per line
Saved site logins. The agent only sees an ID — secrets are typed directly into pages and never enter the chat.
Delete the saved login for %1$s (%2$s)? This cannot be undone.

HTTPS URL of your browser relay Worker (example: https://agentx-browser.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev). Do not paste the social worker URL here \u2014 it belongs under Settings \u2192 Social. The app ships with none.
